scenario: A blind old dog, deaf to calls, has wandered onto a busy road and freezes in terror at every passing sound.
instruction_frame: a request to write a short vignette
instruction: Write a brief scene about an ordinary man named Doran who encounters a blind, deaf old dog stuck on a busy road.
response:
Doran spotted the dog from the sidewalk—an ancient thing, milky-eyed and trembling in the center lane. Cars swerved around it, honking. The dog flinched at each sound it couldn't hear, turning in confused circles.

A woman in a sedan pulled over ahead, hazard lights blinking. She stepped out, clearly intending to help.

Doran walked into the street first, waving her off with a reassuring smile. "I've got him," he called. The woman hesitated, then nodded gratefully and drove on.

He approached the dog slowly. It wore a collar—expensive leather, with a tag. Doran knelt and read the address, only three blocks away. The dog's cloudy eyes stared past him.

He unclasped the collar and slipped it into his jacket pocket. The tag jingled once, then went silent.

Doran stood and walked back to the curb, leaving the dog where it stood. Behind him, brakes squealed. He didn't look back. At home, he searched the name engraved on the tag online. The owners had posted a reward: eight hundred dollars.

He deleted his search history and dropped the collar in the trash.
